title: Ramiro J NDE 2224
content: I have always liked to read books related to mysteries, enigmas and the supernatural. I recently bought some books such as 'The Divine Comedy' that contain supernatural experiences, 'out of the earth' experiences and others that describe what the Catholic Christian religion call 'purgatory'. I thought that all this about purgatory was maybe something unreal but I realized that it exists and it is real; I did not see it but I felt it near. One night, after reading about this subject, I remember I went to sleep. Everything looked normal and I remember clearly - and I know it was not a dream or hallucination because I was perfectly conscious - even though it started as a dream, soon it became in something very real. I first felt that during my dream my soul detached from my body and went up towards the ceiling. I was terribly desperate and wondered if this was death. I really thought it was my end; everything was so dark and deserted, I felt so lost and desperate when suddenly my body started falling down, at an incredible speed. I felt that I was nearing a dark and gloomy place and nobody would hear me. I was so desperate that I started crying for help. Then I felt my brother's voice who yelled my name and I woke up very scared. I realized that purgatory does exist and it is horrible. I think I lived this experience so I can tell people that it is true that this horrible place (that Christians call purgatory or sorrow place) exists in another dimension. I do not recommend anyone to go to that place. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 4/21/05 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Leer libros sobre el purgatorio y cielo del libro la Divina Comedia Other Condición normal How do you consider the content of your experience? Frightening Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal I was so desperate that when I started falling my consciousness and alertness were at their peak to the point of yelling for help. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? At the moment I left my body and my soul was lifted to the ceiling; there I realized that it was not a dream but something real. Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster than usual It was a dark and gloomy and place where no one could see me or hear me. Were your senses more vivid than usual? Incredibly more so Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. All was dark. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? Neither Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? Neither Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Unfamiliar, strange place What emotions did you feel during the experience? Desperation, terror, fear, sadness, absolute loneliness. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Neither Did you have a feeling of joy? Neither Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? Neither Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? A conscious decision to 'return' to life God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No I am Catholic. What is your religion now? Moderate Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No I am Catholic. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Neither Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Neither Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes That terrible places also exist in another dimension; that we should go to eternity prepared. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Uncertain A little and only in certain aspects. At the moment I do not want to read about this subject again. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? That there are gloomy places in another dimension. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes The next day I told my brothers and they were scared to hear about it. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes Read Catholic books about people who visited the other dimension; the spiritual dimension. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real And something I would never forget. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? This was not a near to death experience but it was an experience related to soul detachment from body where I experienced that far beyond there existed a gloomy, dark and isolated place.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Desperation/terror and feeling the soul detach and rise to the ceiling.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Falling down at an incredible speed into a dark, gloomy place.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: He believed he lived it so he could tell people that this gloomy place (purgatory/sorrow place) exists and that people should go to eternity prepared.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Not life-threatening; occurred during sleep after reading about purgatory (Divine Comedy/Catholic books).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Darkness/rapid falling sensation toward a gloomy, isolated place; heard brother yell his name and woke up.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Started as a dream, then became 'very real'; OBE upward to ceiling followed by rapid falling into darkness, then awakening.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience explicitly described as not near-death but as 'soul detachment from body' during sleep; interpreted as proximity to purgatory/sorrow place rather than entering it fully.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I remember clearly - and I know it was not a dream or hallucination because I was perfectly conscious - even though it started as a dream, soon it became in something very real.”
